title: BEST Resume Sections to Include for your Job Search | What to Include in a Template Resume
description:
A resume is your golden ticket to show a recruiter who you are and what you can do—but what resume sections should you include and why? With all the different information that floats around about what you should or shouldn’t include in a resume, it can be difficult to get a clear answer. In this video, our Founder & CEO Dave Fano is going to explain what are the best sections to always include in a resume and which are optional.

To learn more and download the free Chrome extension, head to www.tealhq.com.
